The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio or professional office. She speaks directly to the camera with frequent facial expressions and hand gestures. It aims to answer a common skincare concern—whether sunscreen can prevent melasma (liver spots)—by providing expert-toned advice while encouraging viewers to visit the clinic or contact them for further professional consultation.
